sentence: In accounting firms, AI-infused knowledge pays through green human and structural capital, while the relational channel contributes nothing
passage: [Bin-Nashwan & Li (2025), p. 1] "AIK positively and significantly affected the internal dimensions of GIC, green human capital (GHC) and green structural capital (GSC) within accounting firms, while green rational capital (GRC) had no effect."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly confirms that AI-infused knowledge positively affects green human and structural capital while having no effect on GRC, aligning with the claim.
